source.name: Footy Headlines – Al Sadd SC 26-27 Home Kit Released
source.quote: The New Balance Al Sadd 2026-2027 home jersey features a traditional white base with two vertical black double-stripes, a maroon Qatar Airways sponsor
source.note: The club's official online store gallery for the 26/27 home jersey (store.al-saddclub.com/product/al-sadd-26-27-home-jersey/) shows Qatar Airways centred on the chest; the back and sleeves are plain. The club's own site lists only Qatar Airways and New Balance under 'Our Sponsors'.

source.name: Footy Headlines – Al Sadd SC 26-27 Home Kit Released
source.quote: Al Sadd SC and New Balance have officially released the club's new home kit for the 2026-27 season under the campaign slogan "Move as one".
source.note: Kit maker; the NB logo sits on the right chest of the store product photos. The club's own site lists New Balance under 'Our Sponsors' with a link to newbalance.co.uk.

summary: New Balance 2026/27 home kit. Qatar Airways (maroon) is the only shirt sponsor, centred on the front; the official store photos show a plain back (howling-wolf neckline detail only) and plain sleeves, and the club lists only Qatar Airways and New Balance as sponsors. The shorts are not pictured on the store page, so the list is not confirmed complete.
